spans.s:
रह् रह् (perhaps originally रध्), cl. 1. P.
रहति, रराह, रहितुम्, cl. 10. P. रह-
यति, अररहत् or अरीरहत् (?), रहयितुम्, to
leave, quit, relinquish, abandon, desert, give up,
surrender, resign; [cf. Gr. λανθάνω, ἔλαθον, λάθρα,
ἀλήθης; (probably) ἔρημος; perhaps also λόχος,
λέχος: Lat. lates; lectum, lego: Goth. ligan,
lagjan: Angl. Sax. lecgan, licgan: Lith. leidmi,
leidziu.]

रह, अस्, m. = 1. रहस् below.
—रह-रूढ-
भाव, अस्, आ, अम्, withdrawn into privacy, being
private or in secret.
—रह-सू, ऊस्, f., Ved. a woman
bringing forth (a child) in secret, a bad woman who
conceals the birth of her child.
—रह-स्थ, see
under 1. रहस् below.

रहण, अम्, n. the act of quitting, desertion,
abandonment; separation.
रहयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, quitting, abandoning.

1. रहस्, अस्, n. (for 2. see p. 837, col. 1), loneliness,
solitariness, solitude, privacy, secrecy, retirement, (र-
हसि, in secret, secretly, privily; रहस्सु, privately, in
private, secretly); a lonely or deserted place, private
or solitary abode, hiding-place; a secret, mystery,
mystical truth; sexual intercourse, copulation; a
privity; (अस्), ind. in a solitary place, in secret,
secretly, clandestinely, privately, privily, (opposed to
प्र-काशम्.)
—रहः-स्थ or रह-स्थ, अस्, आ,
अम्, standing or being in a lonely place or in private,
being apart, being alone; being in the enjoyment of
love.
—रहस्-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, executing a secret
commission.
—रही-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., or
रही-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, &c., to withdraw to
a solitary place, retire apart.
—रही-भूत, अस्, आ,
अम्, withdrawn to a lonely place, retired.
—रहो-
[]
गत, अस्, आ, अम्, being in a lonely place, being alone;
secret, clandestine, concealed, private.

रहस् 2. रहस्, अस्, n. = रंहस्, swiftness,
rapidity. (For 1. रहस् see p. 836, col. 3.)
रहस in अनु-र्˚, &c. = 1. रहस्, p. 836, col. 3.

रहसनन्दिन् or रहसानन्दिन् (?), ई, m., N.
of a grammarian.

रहस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, secret, private, clandestine,
concealed; mysterious; fit to be concealed; (अम्),
n. a secret, any secret doctrine or mystery, anything
hidden or recondite, mystical or esoteric teaching;
an Upaniṣad (Manu

); (अम्), ind. in secret,
secretly, privately; (आ), f., N. of a river; of two
plants, = रास्ना; = पाठा.
—रहस्य-त्रय-सार,
‘essence of the three mystical doctrines,’ N. of a
treatise by Veṅkata Ācārya (being a short exposition
in verse of the doctrines of the Vedānta according to
Rāmānuja).
—रहस्य-धारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, secret-
possessing, being in possession of a secret or mystery,
initiated into a secret rite or mystery.
—रहस्य-
भेद, अस्, m. or रहस्य-भेदन, अम्, n. or
रहस्य-विभेद, अस्, m. revealing a secret, dis-
closure of a secret or mystery.
—रहस्य-व्रत, अम्,
n. ‘mystical-vow,’ the mystic science of obtaining
command over magical weapons.
रहस्यु, उस्, m. a proper N.

रहाट, अस्, m. (perhaps for रहो-ऽट), a coun-
sellor, minister; a ghost, spirit; a spring.

रहाय (fr. रहस्), Nom. A. रहायते, &c., to
be lonely or private, &c.

रहित, अस्, आ, अम्, left, quitted, forsaken, aban-
doned, deserted; lonely, solitary; deserted by, sepa-
rated from, free from, deprived of, void or destitute
of, without (with inst. or at the end of comps. or
sometimes at the beginning, e. g. भर्त्रा-रहिता, a
woman separated from her husband; रत्न-रहित
or रहित-रत्न, destitute of gems); (अम्), n. pri-
vacy, secrecy, (रहिते, loc. c. in secret, in privacy,
secretly, privately.)
रही-कृ, रही-भू. See under 1. रहस्, p. 836.

रहूगण रहूगण, आस्, m. pl., N. of a family
belonging to the race of Aṅgiras; (अस्), m., N. of
the author of the hymns Ṛg-veda

राहूगण राहूगण, अस्, m. (fr. रहूगण),
Ved. a patronymic of Gotama; (आस्), m. pl. of the
following word.
राहक्षति राहक्षति, इस्, m. a patronymic.

राहित्य राहित्य, अम्, n. (fr. रहित), the
[]
being without anything, the being destitute of, free-
dom from anything, destitution, destituteness (at the
end of a comp., e. g. कृपा-राहित्य, the being
without compassion).
राहिल राहिल, अस्, m. a proper N.

राहु राहु, उस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. रह्;
probably connected with rts. रभ्, ग्रभ्), ‘the
looser’ or ‘the seizer,’ N. of a Daitya or demon who
is supposed to seize the sun and moon and thus
cause eclipses, (according to the common myth
he was a son of Vipra-citti and Sinhikā, and had
four arms, his lower part ending in a tail; he was the
instigator of all mischief among the Daityas, and
when the gods had produced the Amṛta or nectar
from the churned ocean, he disguised himself like
one of them and drank a portion of it, but the Sun
and Moon having detected his fraud and informed
Viṣṇu, the latter severed his head and two of his
arms from the rest of his body; the portion of nectar
he had swallowed having secured his immortality,
the head and tail were transferred to the stellar
sphere, the head wreaking its vengeance on the Sun
and Moon by occasionally swallowing them for a
time, while the tail, under the name of Ketu, gave
birth to a numerous progeny of comets and fiery
meteors: in astronomy Rāhu is variously regarded
as a dragon's head, as the ascending node of the
moon, or as one of the planets); an eclipse or
(rather) the moment of occultation or obscuration;
the regent of the south-west quarter.
—राहु-गत,
अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. ‘gone to Rāhu,’ darkened, ob-
scured, eclipsed.
—राहु-ग्रसन or राहु-ग्र-
हण, अम्, n. ‘seizure or swallowing by Rāhu,’ an
eclipse of the sun or moon.
—राहु-ग्रस्त, अस्, आ,
अम्, ‘swallowed by Rāhu,’ eclipsed.
—राहु-ग्रास
or राहु-ग्राह, अस्, m. an eclipse of the sun or
moon, the immersion at an eclipse.
—राहु-च्छत्त्र,
अम्, n. green ginger.
—राहु-दर्शन, अम्, n.,
Ved. ‘appearance of Rāhu,’ an eclipse.
—राहु-पर्-
वन्, अ, n. the day or period of an eclipse.
—राहु-
पीडा, f. ‘oppression by Rāhu,’ an eclipse.
—राहु-
पूजा, f. the worship of Rāhu.
—राहु-भेदिन्, ई,
m. ‘severing Rāhu,’ epithet of Viṣṇu.
—राहु-
मूर्ध-भिद्, त्, or राहु-मूर्ध-हर, अस्, m.
‘decapitator of Rāhu,’ epithet of Viṣṇu.
—राहु-
रत्न, अम्, n. Rāhu's jewel, N. of a kind of jewel.
—राहु-संस्पर्श, अस्, m. contact with Rāhu,
i. e. an eclipse of the sun or moon.
—राहु-सूतक,
अम्, n. the birth or appearance of Rāhu, an eclipse
of the sun or moon.
—राहूच्छिष्ट (˚हु-उच्˚) or
राहूत्सृष्ट (˚हु-उत्˚), अम्, n. ‘left or despised by
Rāhu,’ a shalote, Allium Ascalonicum.
राहवि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Rāhu.

राहुल, अस्, m., N. of a son of Śākya-muni; of
a son of Śuddhodana; of a minister of Hiouen-
thsang.
—राहुल-सू, ऊस्, m. father of Rāhula, i. e.
Śākya-muni.
राहुलक, अस्, m., N. of a poet.
राहुलत (?), अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist patriarch.
राहूगण्य, अस्, m. a patronymic.
